mapper.select: SELECT 'EMP' AS user_type, emp_id AS user_id, phone_no AS phone_number FROM tb_emp WHERE hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId} AND ward_id = #{wardId} AND role_cd = 'USER' AND job_cd = 'GENERAL' AND auth_st = 'APPROVED' AND phone_no IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(phone_no) <> '' ORDER BY emp_id

SELECT 'CAREGIVER' AS user_type, emp_id AS user_id, phone_no AS phone_number FROM tb_emp WHERE hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId} AND room_no = #{roomNumber} AND role_cd = 'USER' AND job_cd = 'CAREGIVER' AND auth_st = 'APPROVED' AND phone_no IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(phone_no) <> '' ORDER BY emp_id

SELECT CAST(event_id AS VARCHAR) FROM tb_detection_event WHERE event_type = 'FALL' AND decision_st = 'CONFIRMED' AND (event_detail ->> 'duplicate_of') IS NULL AND crt_dt >= NOW() - (#{minutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute') ORDER BY crt_dt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sms_send_history ( event_id, user_type, user_id, phone_no, message_content, send_status, send_dt ) VALUES ( CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID), #{userType}, #{userId}, #{phoneNumber}, #{messageContent}, #{sendStatus}, CASE WHEN #{sendStatus} = 'SUCCESS' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END )
